import sys, openpyxl
from openpyxl.utils import range_boundaries, get_column_letter
tid=sys.argv[1]; rng=sys.argv[2]
sheet=None
if '!' in rng:
    sheet,rng=rng.split('!'); sheet=sheet.strip("'")
c1,r1,c2,r2=range_boundaries(rng)
base=f"/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/spreadsheetbench-data/all_data_912_v0.1/spreadsheet/{tid}"
for n in [1,2,3]:
    print("="*60,"INSTANCE",n)
    wi=openpyxl.load_workbook(f"{base}/{n}_{tid}_input.xlsx",data_only=True)
    wa=openpyxl.load_workbook(f"{base}/{n}_{tid}_answer.xlsx",data_only=True)
    si=wi[sheet] if sheet else wi.active
    sa=wa[sheet] if sheet else wa.active
    for r in range(r1,r2+1):
        row_i=[si.cell(r,c).value for c in range(c1,c2+1)]
        row_a=[sa.cell(r,c).value for c in range(c1,c2+1)]
        mark=" DIFF" if row_i!=row_a else ""
        print(f"r{r} IN {row_i}")
        if mark: print(f"r{r} AN {row_a}{mark}")
